questions.prompt: Would you please schedule the patient for a medical ____ tomorrow afternoon?
questions.explanation: Sau “a medical” cần danh từ “consultation”, nghĩa là buổi tư vấn/khám bệnh được xếp lịch.

questions.prompt: Your prescription will be ready in an hour, if that's ____ for you.
questions.explanation: “That's convenient for you” dùng tính từ sau “is”, nghĩa là thời gian đó thuận tiện cho bạn.

questions.prompt: The procedure ____ a slight problem, but the doctor assured us not to be alarmed.
questions.explanation: Câu cần động từ quá khứ “detected”, đồng thời với “assured”: thủ thuật đã phát hiện vấn đề nhỏ.

questions.prompt: My doctor has decided to ____ the amount of medication I am taking.
questions.explanation: “Decided to” theo sau bởi nguyên mẫu “limit”, nghĩa là hạn chế lượng thuốc.

questions.prompt: Inform the pharmacist of any other medications you are taking to avoid any ____ drug interactions.
questions.explanation: Trước “drug interactions” cần tính từ “potential” để chỉ những tương tác có thể xảy ra.

questions.prompt: We desperately need ____ to help at the free clinic next month.
questions.explanation: Cần danh từ chỉ người giúp phòng khám. “Volunteers” số nhiều không cần mạo từ; “volunteer” số ít cần “a”.

readingPassage:
Cloverdale Pharmacy
The neighborhood pharmacy that you can rely on!

Cloverdale is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Unlike other pharmacies with limited schedules, we're open all the time. You can rely on us in an emergency at any time of day. And, our schedule makes it [16] ____ for busy working people to fill prescriptions after work or on weekends.

You're always safe with us! When you fill a prescription at Cloverdale, we keep a careful record. This way, we can easily [17] ____ the medications you are taking and inform you of any potentially harmful interactions.

Do you need help selecting over-the-counter medications? Our pharmacists are available to [18] ____ with you and help you choose the medications that suit your needs.

Cloverdale Pharmacy. We're here to serve you.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (16).
questions.explanation: “Make it + tính từ + for someone to” cần “convenient”: giờ mở cửa tạo thuận tiện cho người đi làm.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (17).
questions.explanation: Sau “can” dùng nguyên mẫu chủ động “monitor”; dược sĩ là người theo dõi thuốc khách đang dùng.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (18).
questions.explanation: “Consult with you” nghĩa là tư vấn, trao đổi với bạn để chọn thuốc phù hợp. Các động từ còn lại không có nghĩa này.

readingPassage:
Many people don't realize that their pharmacist is an important member of their health care team. If you always fill your prescriptions at the same pharmacy, then you will have a pharmacist who is familiar with your medical issues and can detect any possible problems with your medications. In fact, it is a good idea to volunteer information about medications you are already taking when you visit a new pharmacist. Then, she can add this information to your records and have a complete file of information. She can monitor the drugs you are taking and let you know of any potential interactions or harmful side effects.

If cost is an issue for you, your pharmacist can help. Ask her if there are any less expensive brands of your medication available. Or, you can request that she fill only half the prescription, to give you a chance to try out the medication before paying for the entire amount. You can also ask your doctor for a few free samples. Once you have ascertained that the prescribed medication is working for you, you can go ahead and ask your pharmacist to fill the prescription for you. When you pick up your prescription, don't forget to ask the pharmacist to explain to you how to take it if you have any doubts. She can also supply you with written instructions.

Your pharmacist can provide you with important support, but there is a limit to what she can do. If you suspect that you have a problem that requires medical attention, you should always consult your doctor right away.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of this article?

choiceTexts.A: To explain the role of a pharmacist.
choiceTexts.C: To give instructions on taking medications.

questions.explanation: Bài trình bày cách dược sĩ hỗ trợ theo dõi thuốc, chi phí và hướng dẫn sử dụng, nên nhằm giải thích vai trò dược sĩ.

questions.prompt: What can you ask your pharmacist to do?
questions.explanation: Đoạn hai nói có thể hỏi dược sĩ về những nhãn thuốc rẻ hơn, tức đề xuất nhãn hiệu khác.

questions.prompt: What should you ask for when you pick up your prescription?
questions.explanation: Khi nhận thuốc, bài khuyên hỏi cách dùng nếu chưa rõ và xin hướng dẫn bằng văn bản.

questions.prompt: The word detect in line 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: “Detect” nghĩa là phát hiện vấn đề có thể xảy ra, gần nghĩa “discover”.

questions.prompt: The word potential in line 8 is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: “Potential” chỉ điều có khả năng xảy ra, tương đương “possible”, không khẳng định nó nguy hiểm hay phổ biến.
